routes.name: Motion Is Proof
routes.premise: The hair's freedom of movement is the product demonstration.
routes.tension_or_insight: Visible volume usually looks controlled by stiffness; this route proves control through movement instead.
routes.hook: A still, polished silhouette breaks into an unexpectedly fluid turn.
routes.architecture: stillness -> movement test -> product reveal -> line
routes.visual_world: Warm minimal studio, close material detail, restrained air movement, clean negative space.
routes.sound_world: Quiet room tone, a soft air rise, one restrained low-frequency resolve.
routes.hero_moment: Hair arcs freely while the silhouette remains lifted and composed.

feasibility.image: Strong as a frozen motion trace.
feasibility.video: Strong; movement directly carries the mechanism.

risks: Movement may look like a generic beauty shot unless the product proof is explicit.
routes.why_it_may_win: The product benefit is demonstrated by the same visual behavior that creates attention.
routes.falsification: Reject if viewers read the movement as styling spectacle rather than light, touchable volume.

routes.name: The Quiet Lift
routes.premise: Invisible air becomes a calm architectural force around the product and hair.
routes.tension_or_insight: Premium control is desirable when its mechanism stays visually quiet.
routes.hook: Fine translucent planes rise almost imperceptibly from a still composition.
routes.architecture: invisible force appears -> structure lifts -> product revealed as source
routes.visual_world: Soft translucent layers, warm white space, precision still life, barely visible motion.
routes.sound_world: Minimal air texture and delicate material resonance.
routes.hero_moment: Hair and translucent planes share one upward geometry without looking rigid.
risks: May communicate design sophistication more strongly than product proof.
routes.why_it_may_win: Distinctive premium world with a recognizable campaign device.
routes.falsification: Reject if the metaphor obscures the practical benefit.

routes.name: Before the Mirror Notices
routes.premise: The result appears inside a real morning before the person has time to perform for the mirror.
routes.tension_or_insight: Effort feels luxurious when it removes self-conscious checking.
routes.hook: An imperfect, candid turn catches naturally lifted hair before a mirror pose begins.
routes.architecture: real morning moment -> accidental proof -> subtle product reveal
routes.visual_world: Natural apartment light, intimate camera-roll framing, quiet realism.
routes.sound_world: Domestic ambience, fabric movement, no overt beauty-ad score.
routes.hero_moment: The subject turns away from the mirror and the hair holds airy movement.

feasibility.video: Strong with live or controlled documentary production.

risks: Can lose premium distinction or become generic creator content.
routes.why_it_may_win: High audience relatability and low-advertising resistance.
routes.falsification: Reject if brand recognition and product memory are too weak.
